errors.problem: Drops the hypothesis of Lemma lem:ordered-affine-streams (paper lines 557-560, 623-627) that the rational coefficients have denominators prime to q; only then is the reduction modulo Q = q^b defined (and computable by extended Euclid in poly(b) time).

errors.quote: Both costs are $O(V)$, as are signed combinations of these operations.
errors.problem: The paper (lines 612-614) says a signed rational unit is a composition of integer multiplications, inverse multiplications and possibly negation; 'signed combinations' suggests linear combinations, which is not meaningful for these permutations. The rational-unit case c/d (numerator and denominator prime to q) is only alluded to.

errors.problem: Overstates: the paper (lines 176-179, 4283-4288) implements the changes of numerical address coordinates by whole-chunk moves (axis swaps via the chunk-swap procedure) together with controlled shifts, plus a deterministic correction of exceptional addresses, not by controlled shifts alone.
